reviews.title: Do NOT order
reviews.body: Do NOT order. We ordered first one on April 22nd. System came in, hooked it up and an error code telling us to check cell came on. We did troubleshooting with no luck.  Amazon was wonderful to send quick replacement. We received that on 4-30-26. Same issue of check cell came on. Called Amazon. They told us to contact company. Company does not answer phone but wants email instead due to “high call volume”. Now I’m stuck with a system that does NOT work and no one from company to talk to. Amazon said they will call me back tomorrow to discuss options after I give the company time to assist me.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 30, 2026

reviews.title: The  XtremepowerUS Saltwater Pool Chlorine Generator system is simply amazing in its efficiency
reviews.body: Amazing results.  I bought this same system last year and then promptly set the jumpers incorrectly for the voltage and blew the system.  Unfortunately, my 40,000 gal system was out of stock so I purchased a different chlorine generator control and put it on my pool.  I could never seem to get the chemicals in balance and my pool had a perpetual green tint from the algae.  After a year of frustration I bought a new 40,000 gal XtremepowerUS system and installed the new chlorine generator control box -- with the jumpers set correctly -- and fired the system up.  It was a matter of hours from the installation my pool lost its green tint and the water started clearing up and the chemicals are back in balance.It's amazing how well this system works and I highly recommend the XtremepowerUS Saltwater Pool Chlorine Generator system to anyone with a saltwater pool.  Or to anyone who wants to convert to a saltwater pool.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on April 6, 2026
reviews.author: essjaypee
